geometry_rules: Ground stays continuous. Low access/return plinths are60px obstacles, jumpable from floor; the lower route goes over these low steps but under every high deck. It is not a flat no-jump speedrun corridor.
Deck y320 and16px thickness leave104px floor clearance, enough for72px hero art. No support/crate colliders in lower passage. Decorative legs are behind play plane and visibly recessed.
Access edge to deck gap40px,rise60px; deck to return gap50px,drop60px.150/250px tops meet120px minimum.
One-way decks admit upward passage; gravity lands on top. Projectile-blocking slab must be thin and art-aligned. Do not reuse floor-to-top solid rectangle for decks.
Shooter foot anchor on deck; projectile emission and sightline must reach hero below with actual aim geometry, not shoot through deck. Place near edge and suppress occluded shots.

timeline_rules.clock: Gameplay time starts only after intro and input-release guard; pause/dialogue/dispenser freeze it. Times are earliest eligibility, not unconditional spawn deadlines.
timeline_rules.queue: Finite12 event IDs. One new warning at a time; at least0.6sec between warning starts. Full budget delays queued event, never deletes live shots or releases accumulated burst.
timeline_rules.placement_refresh: Choose positions from CURRENT viewport at warning start, never stale authored player position. Event role/time fixed; exact home is resolved by rules below.
timeline_rules.safety: At activation recheck viewport,hero bounds,solids,other spawns and predicted landing. Unsafe warning cancels and requeues same ID, never marks kill.
timeline_rules.duration: 20s fixed observation window; safety always wins over schedule. Last event eligible19s leaves little margin: record shortfalls and adjust timing after first measurement rather than violate warning.
timeline_rules.end: Dedicated trial mode ends at20.0 active gameplay seconds with frozen results: issued/12, defeated, active, deferred and unavailable counts, damage and misses. Cancel remaining warnings/queued events without kill credit. Offer retry or return to menu; no story victory or main-level completion. If fewer than12 issued, report the shortfall and cause prominently; this is a pacing/safety diagnostic, not a successful full-sequence claim.
timeline_rules.death: On death, reset trial observation clock and all12 enemy IDs while preserving the normally deducted life count. Do not restore lives on automatic respawn. Zero lives uses normal Game Over. Explicit Retry/new attempt follows existing new-attempt life reset rules. Preserve existing intro replay rules; do not mix trial timers with main mission queue.

forward_edge.logic: Walk in from right edge; no contact until visible warning/reaction elapsed. If right world margin prevents entry, use nearest clear visible floor point >=220px ahead and show warning. Skip candidates on access/return plinths.

rear_edge.logic: Enter from left, after at least one forward threat has become visible. Require>=220px separation at visibility; if camera clamped at start or hero hugs left edge, defer. No teleport behind hero.

visible_deck.logic: Choose nearest fully visible deck ahead with220–420px horizontal separation. Actor width must fit; final collider Art-owned. If no candidate, wait; do not put shooter on floor. After0.8s arrival warning, use Mechanics0.65s shooter windup as sole attack-timing authority. First shot never before0.8s visible; no offscreen attacks.

visible_grate.logic: Pick fully visible grate180–420px ahead,>=160px from predicted hero landing and clear of props.0.8s warning then emergence then0.3s harmless settle. If no safe candidate, defer; no hidden floor damage.

forward_air.logic: One flyer per event with alternating height. Enter from right; follow authored shallow crossing arc, no player-homing spawn. At least0.8s visible warning before attack; no shared swoop destination. Do not substitute non-hunting Septic Air Force.

pickup.status: Use approved exclusive pickup implementation only; not a13th hostile. If pickup mechanics/art are unavailable, report omission in reduced trial, do not disguise health as weapon upgrade.
pickup.route: Carrier crosses above mid deck near y235; reward descends to safe deck or clear floor, no mandatory damage. Never put pickup above reachable height without drop.

unavailable_roles.policy: Engineering should implement missing behaviors with Art-approved source assets. A technical graybox may use explicit debug markers only in headless/internal checks; no production art substitutes.
unavailable_roles.reduced_build: If blocked, ship only as reduced runner/cadence/environment trial, with actual enemy count and omitted roles listed. Do not replace missing roles with more toilets and claim completed12-enemy multi-role trial.
unavailable_roles.priority: First runner cadence and supported scenery, then perched shooter, emerger, aggressive flyer. Full trial signoff waits for all roles.
unavailable_roles.existing_swarm: Optional environmental swarms excluded from this controlled comparison to avoid extra contact variables; retain unchanged in existing full route.
